policy.groups: Number of distinct anonymous IDs already predicted by the frozen full native journal, not reference people
policy.features: All exact previously saved clean>=2s ERes2Net vectors; no new embeddings or selected first profiles
policy.clustering: Cosine dissimilarity, average-link hierarchical clustering, maxclust at predicted group count; one fixed method, no cutoff or group-count scan
policy.displayIdMapping: Global maximum duration agreement between vector clusters and original anonymous IDs; predicted data only
policy.shortIntervals: For a shorter clean run, revise only when preceding and following eligible runs for that original ID have the same reconciled label; otherwise retain original
policy.overlapAndActivity: Preserve all original multivoice intervals, every activity boundary and activity multiplicity; no missing speech is invented
policy.acceptance: Both complete ordinary cases must meet original DER<=10% and old per-person regressions remain explicit; raw/per-person text gates unchanged
policy.stop: One fixed cached-data reconciliation; no parameter variants after full scores

limits.scope: This worker and its descendants only; no global or other-app changes.
